# Dr. Tomás A. Rush

**R&D Associate Staff Member, Microbial Systems Biology**
Biosciences Division
Oak Ridge National Laboratory

* [Oak Ridge National Laboratory profile](https://impact.ornl.gov/en/persons/tomas-rush/)

---

## Biography

Dr. Tomás A. Rush is a plant pathologist and mycologist in the Biosciences Division at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. His research examines the molecular and chemical interactions among plants, fungi, and associated microbial communities, with particular emphasis on signals and specialized metabolites that influence plant health, symbiosis, and disease.

At Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Dr. Rush contributes to research on plant–microbe interfaces, fungal biology, bioenergy crops, microbial community interactions, and the effects of fungal metabolites on plant performance. His work combines plant pathology, mycology, molecular biology, metabolomics, imaging, and computational approaches.

---

## Collaborations

Dr. Rush collaborates with the Briseño Lab on fungal pathogens, mycoviruses, plant–fungal interactions, comparative genomics, and molecular mechanisms affecting fungal development and host impact.
